chapters.title: Bitta butun
chapters.text: Pitsa hali bo‘linmagan. Bu bitta butun.

chapters.title: Yarim
chapters.text: Butunni ikki teng bo‘lakka bo‘ldik. Bitta bo‘lak — 1/2.

chapters.title: Chorak
chapters.text: Butunni to‘rt teng bo‘lakka bo‘ldik. Bitta bo‘lak — 1/4.

chapters.title: Ikki chorak — yarim
chapters.text: To‘rtta teng bo‘lakdan ikkitasi butunning yarmi: 2/4 = 1/2.

chapters.title: Foiz nima?
chapters.text: Foiz — yuzdan bir ulush. 100% bitta butunni bildiradi.

chapters.title: Tenglikni ko‘ramiz
chapters.text: 2x + 3 = 11. Ikkala tomondagi qiymat teng.

chapters.title: Ikkala tomondan ayiramiz
chapters.text: Ikkala tomondan 3 ni ayiramiz: 2x = 11 − 3 = 8.

chapters.title: Teng guruhlarga bo‘lamiz
chapters.text: Ikkala tomonni 2 ga bo‘lamiz: x = 8 ÷ 2 = 4.

chapters.title: Tekshiramiz
chapters.text: Topilgan x ni qo‘yamiz: 2 × 4 + 3 = 11. Tenglik to‘g‘ri.

chapters.title: Ertalab
chapters.text: I get up at seven. Men soat yettida turaman.

chapters.title: Maktabga yo‘l
chapters.text: She goes to school every day. She bilan go o‘rniga goes ishlatiladi.

chapters.title: Inkor gap
chapters.text: I don’t play in the morning. I bilan inkorda don’t va fe’lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

visual.label: I don’t play in the morning.

chapters.title: Savol
chapters.text: Does he read every day? Does dan keyin fe’lning asosiy shakli keladi.

chapters.title: Kechagi voqea
chapters.text: I played football yesterday. Oddiy fe’lga -ed qo‘shib, o‘tgan voqeani aytamiz.

chapters.title: Maxsus shakl
chapters.text: I went to school yesterday. Go fe’lining Past Simple shakli went.

chapters.title: Inkor
chapters.text: I didn’t play yesterday. Didn’t dan keyin fe’lning asosiy shakli keladi.

chapters.title: Savol
chapters.text: Did you see the film? Did dan keyin see ishlatiladi.

chapters.title: Tajriba
chapters.text: I have visited Bukhara. Present Perfect: have yoki has va past participle.

chapters.title: Hozirgi natija
chapters.text: She has finished her homework. She bilan has ishlatiladi.

chapters.title: Aniq o‘tgan vaqt
chapters.text: I visited Bukhara yesterday. Yesterday aniq o‘tgan vaqt bo‘lgani uchun Past Simple ishlatiladi.

chapters.title: Maxsus fe’l
chapters.text: He has seen this film. See fe’lining past participle shakli seen.

chapters.title: Maqsad
chapters.text: Robot kitobni olib, javonga qo‘yishi kerak. Maqsadni aniqlaymiz.

chapters.title: Birinchi qadam
chapters.text: Robot kitobga yaqinlashadi.

chapters.title: Ikkinchi qadam
chapters.text: Robot kitobni oladi. Buyruqlar ketma-ket bajariladi.

chapters.title: Uchinchi qadam
chapters.text: Robot kitobni javonga qo‘yadi. Aniq tartibdagi buyruqlar algoritmni hosil qiladi.

chapters.title: Shartni tekshiramiz
chapters.text: Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, soyabon olamiz.

chapters.title: Aks holda
chapters.text: Yomg‘ir yog‘masa, soyabonsiz borish mumkin. Boshqa yo‘l tanlanadi.

chapters.title: Sonli shart
chapters.text: Agar ball kamida 70 bo‘lsa, maqsadga yetildi. 78 ≥ 70 — to‘g‘ri.

chapters.title: Yolg‘on shart
chapters.text: 60 ≥ 70 — noto‘g‘ri. Dastur aks holda tarmog‘ini bajaradi.

chapters.title: Takroriy buyruq
chapters.text: Uchta yulduz chizish uchun bir xil buyruq uch marta bajariladi.

chapters.title: Birinchi takror
chapters.text: Birinchi takrorlashda bitta yulduz hosil bo‘ladi.

chapters.title: Ikkinchi takror
chapters.text: Ikkinchi takrorlashda yana bitta yulduz hosil bo‘ladi.

chapters.title: Uchinchi takror
chapters.text: Uchinchi takrorlash tugadi. Jami uchta yulduz hosil bo‘ldi.
